name: Philips 55OLED707/12 / 55OLED887/12 / 77OLED806/12 / 65OLED707/12 (TP Vision, PH1M_EA_9970A, MediaTek MT5895), UK, Poland, Germany and Croatia
warnings: That file's quirks and its DO NOT DISABLE block apply here as written; read them first.
Nothing in its DO NOT DISABLE block is disabled below: eum, aurora, xtv, playtv, contentexplorer, homeintentresolver and the browser engine all stay on.
At every boot org.droidtv.tv.tptvservice (TPTvServiceReceiver) puts screen_off_timeout and sleep_timeout back to 604800000 ms, "Never", logging "screensaver put when to start is not never".
It drifts the clock to spare the panel and starts only on Home, never over an app or Live TV.

It is re-enabled here, as the browser-engine entry in the 50PUS8517 DO NOT DISABLE block says it should be. 2. com.phorus.playfi.tv (Play-Fi) could NOT be kept disabled and is commented out below, like mediashell in 50PUS8517 quirk 4.
